Code for one version (code panel)

Source: R/code.R
kit_code.Rd

An S3 value object (class kit_code): code text plus a version name. It has an htmltools::as.tags() method: put it straight into a page and it renders a line with "version name (bold) + Copy" and the code box below, with the code first wrapped by kit_code_wrap() to at most 70 columns per line (Chinese characters count as 2). If a line is still too long after wrapping (e.g. a long string that cannot be broken), it gives a warning (it does not stop), and the box scrolls sideways.

Usage

kit_code(code, label = "R", width = KIT_CODE_WIDTH)

# S3 method for class 'kit_code'
as.tags(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kit_code'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kit_code'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

code

The code (a character vector; one element per line, or containing newlines).

label

The version name, e.g. "tidyverse 版" ("tidyverse version"), "base R 版" ("base R version"), "kits 版" ("kits version").

width

Maximum columns per line; NULL means no wrapping and no check.

x

A kit_code object.

...

Not used.

Value

A kit_code object.

See also

kit_code_blocks(), kit_code_panel_ui()

Examples

x <- kit_code("joined <- dplyr::left_join(t1, t2, by = \"id\")", "tidyverse 版")
x
#> ## tidyverse 版
#> joined <- dplyr::left_join(t1, t2, by = "id")
htmltools::as.tags(x)
#> <div class="kit-code-head">
#>   <strong>tidyverse 版</strong>
#>   <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary kit-copy">複製</button>
#> </div>
#> <pre><code>joined &lt;- dplyr::left_join(t1, t2, by = "id")</code></pre>
